 IonQ Slides as Investors Digest Strong Q3 Results and Recent Analyst Target Cuts
 By: Quiver PriceTracker
 Posted: 7 hours ago / Nov. 12, 2026 4:21 p.m. UTC 
 IONQ
 IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) is down 4.7% today. Here is some analysis on what might have caused this price movement.
 Analysis: The most likely driver appears to be post-earnings digestion rather than a single fresh negative announcement. IonQ recently posted record third-quarter revenue, lifted its full-year outlook, and highlighted a larger backlog, but investors may be balancing those positives against ongoing losses, integration risk from recent acquisitions, and a round of lower analyst price targets after the report.
 Details: IonQ announced third-quarter 2026 revenue of $173.8 million, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $505 million to $515 million, and said backlog reached $1.2 billion.
 The company’s latest quarterly filing shows the Elisity acquisition closed on November 3, 2026, adding another integration step for investors to evaluate.
 IonQ’s quarterly filing also showed operating losses remained substantial, even as revenue accelerated, which can pressure sentiment in a volatile growth stock.
 Following the earnings release, several analysts reduced their price targets, suggesting that while the business outlook improved, valuation expectations were reset lower.
 Sources: 
 IonQ Investor Relations, SEC, Google Finance
 Disclaimer: This price movement analysis was generated with the help of AI. Please double-check the information provided for mistakes.
